name: deep-thinking
description: Human-led clarification, evidence research, independent challenge, and a defensible outcome with visible progress and ending.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify, research, challenge, and form a defensible view
interface.longDescription: A human-led inquiry workflow for Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, and zCode. Clarify intent, examine evidence and competing explanations, seek Alpha on a dependable Beta, and deliver an independent result with clear conditions. Includes method references and inquiry templates; no background runner or mandatory external service.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $deep-thinking to work through my question, investigate pivotal evidence, and deliver a defensible outcome.
